items.title: NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC information-sharing pact, TokenPost reports
items.content_text: - **NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC information-sharing pact, TokenPost reports** — TokenPost reports the NBA announced on Oct. 26, 2026 that Kalshi and Polymarket are its preferred prediction market exchanges under multi-year agreements giving both rights to NBA intellectual property and official data through Sportradar for authorized markets. items.title: Polymarket Brazil odds face scrutiny after Lula won despite being priced at about 20 percent, Cryptopolitan reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket Brazil odds face scrutiny after Lula won despite being priced at about 20 percent, Cryptopolitan reports** — Cryptopolitan reports Polymarket priced Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva at about a 20 percent chance of winning the Brazilian election against about 80 percent for Flavio Bolsonaro, but Lula won the second-round vote on Sunday. Trader FhantomBets, quoted in the report, said veteran traders put Lula closer to 30 to 40 percent and blamed retail traders for holding the price down even after the result was effectively certain. items.title: Nevada court issues 14-day restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment contracts in the state, GambleRss reports
items.content_text: - **Nevada court issues 14-day restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment contracts in the state, GambleRss reports** — GambleRss reported Nevada's First Judicial District Court granted a 14-day temporary restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment event contracts in the state, the first time a state has forced a prediction market to halt operations. The court said the Nevada Gaming Control Board is reasonably likely to succeed on the merits, finding sports event contracts qualify as a sports pool under Nevada law and that Kalshi taking a commission makes it a percentage game. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/kalshi-facing-temporary-nevada-ban-following-court-ruling-59956))

items.title: Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding the law likely preempted by CFTC exclusive jurisdiction, GambleRss reports
items.content_text: - **Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding the law likely preempted by CFTC exclusive jurisdiction, GambleRss reports** — GambleRss reported Judge Katherine Menendez issued a 44-page ruling granting preliminary injunctive relief to the CFTC, Kalshi and Polymarket US, concluding Minnesota's prediction market statute is likely at least partially preempted because the CFTC has exclusive jurisdiction over swaps traded on designated contract markets. The ruling found the platforms faced irreparable harm from possible criminal prosecution and substantial liability if trades had to be cancelled. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/federal-judge-blocks-minnesota-s-proposed-prediction-markets-ban-66705))

items.title: Phantom launches Kalshi prediction markets for US users inside its wallet app, PredictionAuthority reports
items.content_text: - **Phantom launches Kalshi prediction markets for US users inside its wallet app, PredictionAuthority reports** — Phantom is rolling out Kalshi prediction market access to US users starting Oct. 23, allowing trades directly inside the Phantom app funded with the CASH stablecoin through Phantom Cash accounts at 0.02 dollars per contract plus a network fee. Users become direct Kalshi members through Kalshi KYC, following a March 2026 CFTC no-action letter that allowed non-custodial interfaces to connect users to registered exchanges without registering as a broker.
